sourceBoundary: Targeted global oncology surveillance via sponsor primary announcements, FDA primary regulatory record, ClinicalTrials.gov indexed records and dated CTG/CTIS mirrors. No exhaustive worldwide reconciliation. Current CTG API unavailable; treat mirror-only protocol/status transitions as provisional. Identified on October 18 but source events dated Oct 5-15. No medical treatment or individual matching claims.

studies.name: ACTION-1 — RYZ101 following Lu-177-based radiopharmaceutical therapy
studies.molecularEligibility: Somatostatin receptor-positive (SSTR+) advanced inoperable GEP-NET; prior progression after 177Lu-labeled somatostatin analog therapy; SSTR is an expression/imaging biomarker, not a genomic mutation.
interventions: Investigator-selected everolimus, sunitinib or long-acting somatostatin analogue
institutions: Sunnybrook Health Sciences Centre / University of Toronto (principal investigator institution)
endpoints: Progression-free survival by blinded independent central review (primary, Phase 3)
Phase 1b safety, tolerability and recommended Phase 3 dose
studies.limitations: Primary numerical PFS data not disclosed; FDA authorization not granted. Exact site statuses and transition date require official registry history reconciliation.

studies.name: TARGET-D 101 — VS-7375 in KRAS G12D-mutant solid tumors
cancer: Other advanced KRAS G12D-mutated solid tumors
studies.molecularEligibility: Documented KRAS G12D mutation in advanced unresectable or metastatic solid tumors; RECIST-measurable disease; ECOG performance status 0-1 and protocol-specific prior-treatment and CNS criteria.
biomarkers: Circulating tumor DNA KRAS G12D VAF (exploratory)
interventions: VS-7375 oral KRAS G12D ON/OFF inhibitor
VS-7375 plus carboplatin, pemetrexed and pembrolizumab
institutions: NYU Langone Health / Perlmutter Cancer Center
University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center
endpoints: Dose-limiting toxicities, safety, tolerability, maximum tolerated/feasible dose
Objective response rate by RECIST v1.1
Duration of response, disease control, progression-free survival
studies.limitations: Sponsor data are early nonrandomized cohorts. The Oct 15 enrollment expansion is mirror-derived; official CTG search excerpt still reflects Apr 22 enrollment of 295. No Phase 3 study activation is established.

studies.name: HER2CLIMB-05 — tucatinib maintenance in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer
cancer: HER2-positive unresectable locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer
studies.molecularEligibility: HER2-positive tumor after 4-8 cycles of trastuzumab, pertuzumab and taxane induction without progression; HER2 positivity is a receptor-based tumor marker, not necessarily an ERBB2 point mutation.
institutions: Multinational study; individual institution list not independently reconciled
studies.limitations: New event is US regulatory authorization on Oct 7; not an October recruitment or phase transition. Overall survival immature at PFS analysis. Different EU process was already separately tracked.

events.finding: Bristol Myers Squibb announced statistically significant, clinically meaningful improvement in BICR progression-free survival for RYZ101 versus investigator-selected SoC in SSTR+ GEP-NETs after prior 177Lu therapy.
events.limitations: No numerical PFS effect size, confidence interval, detailed safety dataset or mature overall-survival results released; investigational product not yet approved.
events.researchAction: Update alpha-emitting radiopharmaceutical evidence tier; track detailed presentation, OS and regulatory review.

events.finding: ClinicalTrials.gov-derived history reports Recruiting to Active, not recruiting and estimated 338 to actual 343 participants, posted October 5.
events.limitations: Transition established through registry-derived mirror rather than a direct ClinicalTrials.gov version download; do not activate recruitment matching.
events.researchAction: Disable new-participant matching for ACTION-1 and require current site confirmation.

events.finding: Verastem reported 900 mg VS-7375 monotherapy confirmed ORR 50% (4/8) in second-line PDAC and 41% (9/22) in second-or-later-line PDAC; at 600 mg, confirmed ORR 43% (10/23) in previously treated NSCLC. In 12 evaluable KRAS G12D PDAC ctDNA-positive participants, 7/12 had undetectable KRAS G12D ctDNA by C3D1.
events.limitations: Small uncontrolled sponsor-reported cohorts; ctDNA is exploratory and not a validated survival surrogate; there is no Phase 3 efficacy result or approval.
events.researchAction: Add mutation-specific cohort estimates with denominator and dose; keep nonrandomized evidence tier and experimental status.

events.finding: Registry-derived October 15 version records planned enrollment increased from 295 to 616 and revised eligibility, outcomes and interventions; Macquarie University Sydney site added.
events.limitations: Primary registry accessible indexed excerpt was dated April 22 and still displayed 295; direct current ClinicalTrials.gov version-history/API reconciliation unavailable. This is not a phase transition.
events.researchAction: Version-control amended registry details; flag planned enrollment as provisional and reconfirm molecular criteria for patient matching.

events.finding: FDA approved tucatinib with trastuzumab and pertuzumab following induction for adults with unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer. In 654-patient HER2CLIMB-05, median PFS 24.9 vs 16.3 months; HR 0.64 (95% CI 0.51-0.80), p<0.0001.
events.limitations: US approval only; no implication of another jurisdiction's authorization. OS data immature and study not currently recruiting.
events.researchAction: Add US indication-level authorization distinct from previously tracked EU CHMP recommendation; retain biomarker, prior-treatment and OS caveats.
